svg.title: Rat · Agouti
svg.desc: Large agouti laboratory rat with banded brown-gray fur, robust upright trunk, broad muzzle, and substantial tail. Biological basis: Agouti pigment banding creates a grizzled brown coat; the larger body and broader appendages separate the rat silhouette from the mouse.
